text:
[Council File 26-1639; CD 9]
Categorical Exemption from the provisions of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article 9, Sections 15301, 15303(e), and 15304(b) of the California CEQA Guidelines, and Article III, Section 1, Class 1(1), Class 3(6), and Class 4(3) of the City CEQA Guidelines; Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report and Resolution relative to the conceptual approval and a proposed Lease Agreement with Heart of Los Angeles Youth, Inc. for the proposed Green Meadows Pavilion Project located at 431 East 89th Street.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - JANUARY 11, 2027 LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - JANUARY 8, 2027
summary: Gives conceptual approval and a proposed lease to Heart of Los Angeles Youth, Inc. for the Green Meadows Pavilion project at 431 East 89th Street.
